description: Write schema.org JSON-LD for a page: a software app, product, FAQ, organization, article or breadcrumb trail, from the properties you give. Answers the JSON-LD, the script tag to paste, and notes on what Google still requires ("fix") or recommends ("improve") for that type. Mark up only what the page itself shows; never invent a rating. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

items.description: Rows for FAQPage ({ name: the question, value: its answer }) and BreadcrumbList ({ name: the step, value: its URL }).

values.description: The type's properties by key. SoftwareApplication: name, description, url, image, applicationCategory, operatingSystem, price, priceCurrency, ratingValue, ratingCount. Product: name, description, image, brand, sku, url, price, priceCurrency, availability, ratingValue, ratingCount. Organization: name, url, logo, description, email, sameAs. Article: headline, description, url, image, datePublished, dateModified, authorName, authorUrl, publisherName.

name: generate_schema_markup
title: Write schema markup (JSON-LD)
